mapper.select: SELECT * FROM work_order WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM work_order WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY priority ASC, reported_at ASC
SELECT * FROM work_order WHERE assigned_worker_id = #{assignedWorkerId} AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED')
SELECT * FROM work_order WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND fault_type_id = #{faultTypeId} AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_order (order_no, equipment_id, fault_type_id, fault_description, fault_level, status, reporter_id, assigned_worker_id, assigned_crew_id, priority, reported_at, dispatched_at, accepted_at, arrived_at, completed_at, closed_at, parent_order_id, remark, version) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{equipmentId}, #{faultTypeId}, #{faultDescription}, #{faultLevel}, #{status}, #{reporterId}, #{assignedWorkerId}, #{assignedCrewId}, #{priority}, #{reportedAt}, #{dispatchedAt}, #{acceptedAt}, #{arrivedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{parentOrderId}, #{remark}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order SET status = #{newStatus}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE work_order SET status = #{status}, assigned_worker_id = #{assignedWorkerId}, assigned_crew_id = #{assignedCrewId}, priority = #{priority}, dispatched_at = #{dispatchedAt}, accepted_at = #{acceptedAt}, arrived_at = #{arrivedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, remark = #{remark}, fault_level = #{faultLevel}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
